abstract.p: We evaluate Rec-R1 only as motivation in this abstract; this is not experimental comparison evidence.

p.s: For multi-round recommendation, Rec-R1 [1] applies reinforcement learning, while ELASTIC [2] compresses long histories.
Memory and denoising methods include RaSeRec [3], SSDRec [4], and PDRec [5].
Table 1 compares CurrentNet and StrongBase on the MIND benchmark using NDCG@10.
We evaluate every method with the same candidate pool, chronological split, negative samples, fixed random seeds, and identical text encoder so the comparison isolates the history modeling mechanism.
The implementation uses a frozen preprocessing pipeline, reports Recall and NDCG at multiple cutoffs, and repeats each configuration to measure the variation across training runs.

Ablation results separately remove profile memory and latent compression while keeping optimization, evaluation data, and ranking metrics unchanged across all reported settings. The complete protocol is documented for reproducibility.
